## COMPREHENSIVE EXPLORATION REPORT: /src/components/collaboration/ & /src/hooks/

### 1. FILE INVENTORY & EXPORTS

**Collaboration Components** (10 files, 1,224 lines total):

| File | Lines | Primary Exports | Props |
|------|-------|-----------------|-------|
| **share-dialog.tsx** | 318 | `ShareDialog` | `open`, `onOpenChange`, `projectId`, `projectName?`, `canManage?` |
| **notification-bell.tsx** | 215 | `NotificationBell` | (none - standalone) |
| **activity-feed.tsx** | 126 | `ActivityFeed` | `projectId`, `limit?` |
| **comments-panel.tsx** | 192 | `CommentsPanel` | `projectId`, `entityType?`, `entityId?` |
| **cursor-indicators.tsx** | 58 | `CursorIndicators`, `CollaborationPresence`, `ActiveUsersIndicator` | `projectId` (all) |
| **presence-avatars.tsx** | 66 | `PresenceAvatars` | `projectId`, `className?` |
| **editing-indicator.tsx** | 48 | `EditingIndicator`, `EditingBadge` | `users[]`, `itemName?`, `itemType?` / `isEditing`, `editorName?` |
| **item-presence.tsx** | 54 | `ItemPresence`, `ItemPresenceBadge` | `itemType`, `itemId`, `users[]`, `className?` / `users[]`, `showCount?` |
| **mention-input.tsx** | 136 | `MentionInput`, `parseCommentMentions()` | `value`, `onChange`, `placeholder?`, `users?[]`, `disabled?`, `rows?` |
| **version-history.tsx** | 10 | `VersionHistory` | `projectId` (wrapper) |

---

### 2. API HOOKS USED (use-collaboration.ts)

**Query Hooks** (polling-based, 30s intervals):
- `useListRichTasks(projectId, filter?, sort?)` — 30s staleTime
- `useListSubtasks(taskId, projectId?)`
- `useListTaskDependencies(projectId, taskId)`
- `useListComments(entityType, entityId, projectId?)` — 30s staleTime
- `useListActivity(projectId, limit?)` — 30s refetch interval, 15s staleTime
- `useListShares(projectId)`
- `useListNotifications()` — 30s refetch interval
- `useListPresence(projectId)` — 30s refetch interval **[CRITICAL: CURRENTLY RETURNS EMPTY ARRAY]**
- `useListProjectUsers(projectId)` — 60s staleTime

**Mutation Hooks** (all invalidate relevant query caches):
- `useCreateRichTask()`, `useUpdateRichTask()`, `useDeleteRichTask()`
- `useCreateSubtask()`, `useToggleSubtask()`, `useDeleteSubtask()`
- `useAddTaskDependency()`, `useRemoveTaskDependency()`
- `useCreateComment()`, `useDeleteComment()`
- `useCreateShare()`, `useUpdateShare()`, `useRemoveShare()`
- `useMarkNotificationRead()`, `useMarkAllNotificationsRead()`, `useDeleteNotification()`

---

### 3. DATA STRUCTURES

**CollaboratorUser** (minimal user info):
```typescript
{
  id: number;
  email: string | null;
  firstName: string | null;
  lastName: string | null;
  imageUrl: string | null;
}
```

**NotificationItem** (notification-bell.tsx displays this):
```typescript
{
  id: string;
  type: "comment" | "mention" | "assignment" | "status_change" | "invite" | "due_soon" | "system";
  title: string;
  message: string;
  projectId?: number;
  projectName?: string;
  entityType?: string;
  entityId?: number;
  actor?: CollaboratorUser;  // WHO triggered the notification
  read: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  actionUrl?: string;
}
```

**PresenceUser** (presence-avatars.tsx & cursor-indicators.tsx use this):
```typescript
{
  userId: number;
  userName: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
  cursorX: number;           // For CursorIndicators overlay
  cursorY: number;           // For CursorIndicators overlay
  section: string | null;    // "project", "section-name", null = offline
  lastSeen: string;
}
```

**ActivityLogEntry** (activity-feed.tsx displays this):
```typescript
{
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  user: CollaboratorUser;
  action: "created" | "updated" | "deleted" | "commented" | "assigned" | "moved" | "joined" | "shared";
  entityType: string;        // "task", "note", "rule", etc.
  entityId: number;
  entityTitle: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  createdAt: string;
}
```

**ProjectShare** (share-dialog.tsx displays members & pending invites):
```typescript
{
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  user: CollaboratorUser | null;    // null = pending invite
  email: string | null;              // populated for pending invites
  role: ProjectRole;                 // "owner" | "admin" | "editor" | "commenter" | "viewer"
  invitedBy: CollaboratorUser;
  createdAt: string;
}
```

**TaskComment** (comments-panel.tsx displays threaded comments):
```typescript
{
  id: number;
  entityType: "task" | "note" | "rule" | "asset" | "project";
  entityId: number;
  parentId: number | null;           // Threaded replies
  author: CollaboratorUser;
  content: string;
  mentions: number[];                // User IDs extracted from @mentions
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
```

**ProjectRole + Permissions** (share-dialog.tsx role selector):
- Roles: `"owner" | "admin" | "editor" | "commenter" | "viewer"`
- Permissions matrix: `canEdit`, `canComment`, `canShare`, `canDelete`, `canManageMembers`

---

### 4. COMPONENT BREAKDOWN

**share-dialog.tsx** (318 lines):
- **Props**: `open`, `onOpenChange`, `projectId`, `projectName?`, `canManage?`
- **Features**:
  - Invite by email with role selector (admin/editor/commenter/viewer)
  - Public link toggle with permission level control
  - Two-state member list: active members (with role dropdowns) + pending invites
  - Avatar display, name/email display, role labels
  - API calls: `useListShares()`, `useCreateShare()`, `useUpdateShare()`, `useRemoveShare()`
- **Missing**: No "online status" indicator for members; no live presence integration

**notification-bell.tsx** (215 lines):
- **Props**: None (standalone)
- **Displays**:
  - Unread count badge (red, top-right)
  - Popover with scrollable notification list (320px height)
  - Per-notification: avatar + actor name, title, message, timestamp, unread indicator, delete button
  - "Mark all read" button when unread count > 0
- **Icon mapping**: comment→MessageSquare, mention→AtSign, assignment→UserCheck, status_change→GitCommit, due_soon→AlertTriangle
- **API calls**: `useListNotifications()`, `useMarkNotificationRead()`, `useMarkAllNotificationsRead()`, `useDeleteNotification()`
- **Poll interval**: 30s
- **Missing**: No WebSocket fallback; no action navigation on notification click

**activity-feed.tsx** (126 lines):
- **Props**: `projectId`, `limit?` (default 50)
- **Displays**:
  - Filter buttons (All + action types: created/updated/deleted/commented/assigned/moved/joined/shared)
  - Scrollable activity list with: avatar, user name, action badge (colored), entity title, timestamp
- **API call**: `useListActivity(projectId, limit?)` — 30s refetch
- **Icon mapping**: created→Plus, updated→Pencil, deleted→Trash2, commented→MessageSquare, assigned→UserPlus, moved→ArrowRight, joined→UserPlus, shared→GitCommit
- **Missing**: No filtering on backend (all client-side); no "jump to entity" link

**comments-panel.tsx** (192 lines):
- **Props**: `projectId`, `entityType?` (default "task"), `entityId?`
- **Displays**:
  - Comment count badge
  - Threaded comments: parent + children (nested, indented)
  - Per-comment: avatar, name, timestamp, content (pre-wrapped), Reply/Delete buttons
  - MentionInput at bottom with Reply-to indicator
- **Features**: @mention support with user autocomplete dropdown (arrow keys + enter/tab/escape)
- **API calls**: `useListComments()`, `useCreateComment()`, `useDeleteComment()`, `useListProjectUsers()` (for mention suggestions)
- **Missing**: No mention notifications when someone @'s you; no "edit comment" feature

**cursor-indicators.tsx** (58 lines):
- **Exports**:
  - `CursorIndicators({ projectId })` — Fixed overlay rendering live cursor positions + name labels
  - `CollaborationPresence({ projectId })` — Wrapper around PresenceAvatars
  - `ActiveUsersIndicator({ projectId? })` — Right-aligned presence avatars
- **Data source**: `useListPresence(projectId)` — **CURRENTLY RETURNS []**
- **Cursor styling**: SVG cursor with name badge, 6-color rotation
- **Missing**: WebSocket integration (commented as "ready for WS upgrade")

**presence-avatars.tsx** (66 lines):
- **Props**: `projectId`, `className?`
- **Displays**:
  - "N viewing" label
  - Up to 5 stacked avatar circles with ring borders
  - "+N more" badge if >5 users
  - 3 green pulsing dots (top-right) for active users
  - Tooltip: user name + section/role + "active now"
- **API call**: `useListPresence(projectId)` — 30s refetch
- **Missing**: No cursor tracking; no section-specific presence

**editing-indicator.tsx** (48 lines):
- **Components**:
  - `EditingIndicator`: Shows "X is editing 'item-name'" with spinning pencil icon
  - `EditingBadge`: Compact badge showing editor's name + initial avatar
- **Props**: Takes user arrays with `userId` & `userName`
- **Missing**: No integration with any hook; purely presentational (parent must track editing state)

**item-presence.tsx** (54 lines):
- **Components**:
  - `ItemPresence`: Shows "N viewing" with stacked avatar initials + Eye icon
  - `ItemPresenceBadge`: Green pulsing dot + count badge
- **Props**: Takes user arrays with `userId` & `userName`
- **Missing**: No real-time updates; parent must fetch and pass user arrays

**mention-input.tsx** (136 lines):
- **Props**: `value`, `onChange`, `placeholder?`, `users?[]`, `disabled?`, `rows?`
- **Features**:
  - Detects `@` trigger + filters users by typing
  - Arrow keys navigate suggestions, Enter/Tab inserts mention
  - Inserts as `@UserName ` (preserves position)
- **Exports**: Helper `parseCommentMentions(content)` — Regex extracts @names (unused in current codebase)
- **Data**: `MentionableUser` interface = `{ userId: string; userName: string; avatarUrl?: string }`
- **Missing**: No mention notification dispatch; no server-side @mention parsing

**version-history.tsx** (10 lines):
- Wrapper around `<ProjectVersions />` from workspace module (not fully explored here)

---

### 5. WORKSPACE MEMBER / ONLINE USER DATA AVAILABLE

**Sources of user data in collaboration system**:

1. **share-dialog.tsx**: `useListShares()` → `ProjectShare[]` with:
   - Active members: `share.user` (CollaboratorUser) + `share.role`
   - Pending members: `share.email` + `share.role`
   - NO online status, NO cursor position, NO section info

2. **comments-panel.tsx**: `useListProjectUsers()` → `CollaboratorUser[]`
   - Used for @mention autocomplete only
   - NO online status, NO role info

3. **activity-feed.tsx**: `useListActivity()` → `ActivityLogEntry[]` with `user` (CollaboratorUser)
   - Historical data only, not live presence

4. **presence-avatars.tsx** + **cursor-indicators.tsx**: `useListPresence()` → **CURRENTLY RETURNS []**
   - **THIS IS THE MISSING PIECE** — Should return `PresenceUser[]` with:
     - `userId`, `userName`, `avatarUrl`, `section`, `lastSeen`
     - Cursor position (`cursorX`, `cursorY`)
   - API stub exists: `/projects/:id/presence` — backend probably returns empty or is unimplemented

5. **notification-bell.tsx**: `useListNotifications()` → `NotificationItem[]` with `actor` (optional CollaboratorUser)
   - Notification originator info only

---

### 6. CRITICAL GAPS FOR UNIFIED DASHBOARD

**Missing data / integrations**:

1. **Real-time Presence**: `useListPresence()` returns `[]` — WebSocket commented as "ready for upgrade" but not implemented
   - Cannot show live "who is viewing" or cursor positions
   - Polling interval: 30s (stale for real-time collab)

2. **Online Status per Member**: 
   - share-dialog shows members but no "online/offline" badge
   - No last-seen timestamp integration

3. **Section/Area Awareness**:
   - `PresenceUser.section` exists but not tied to UI sections
   - No "which task are they editing" awareness

4. **Member Activity Timeline**:
   - activity-feed is project-wide, not per-member
   - No "John has done X, Y, Z in the last 30 min" view

5. **Unified Member Card**:
   - No single component showing: avatar, name, role, online status, section, last action

6. **Mention Notifications**:
   - `mention-input.tsx` parses mentions client-side
   - `parseCommentMentions()` is unused
   - No server dispatch to mentioned users

7. **WebSocket Integration**:
   - All polling (30s intervals)
   - No real-time updates
   - Presence API explicitly returns empty: `export async function listPresence(_projectId: number): Promise<PresenceUser[]> { return []; }`

---

### 7. KEY FINDINGS SUMMARY

| Category | Status | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| **Share/Access Management** | ✅ Complete | Email invite, role selector, public links, pending state |
| **Notifications** | ✅ Complete | Bell with badge, types, actor display, mark read/delete |
| **Activity Log** | ✅ Complete | Time-series, action icons, filterableClient-side |
| **Comments/Threading** | ✅ Complete | Nested replies, @mention autocomplete, delete |
| **Presence Avatars** | ⚠️ Partial | UI ready but `useListPresence()` returns [] |
| **Cursor Indicators** | ❌ Not working | Full UI implementation but no presence data |
| **Online Status** | ❌ Missing | No indicator in share-dialog or member lists |
| **Member Profiles** | ❌ Missing | No unified "member card" component |
| **Real-time Sync** | ❌ Missing | All polling (30s), no WebSocket |
| **Editing State** | ✅ Component ready | `EditingIndicator` UI exists, no backend integration |

---
